purpose: Deterministic data-free oracle for the mean/variance-rescale event-veto primitives; it is implementation preflight only and contains no scientific outcome.

numeric_contract.mean: mu=sequential_sum(x[0],...,x[N-1])/N with one float64 addition per listed element and no reassociation
numeric_contract.population_variance: v=sequential_sum((x[n]-mu)*(x[n]-mu),n=0,...,N-1)/N with float64 subtraction and multiplication and no reassociation
numeric_contract.rescale: a=sqrt(v_sham/v_intervention); x_rescaled[n]=mu_sham+a*(x_intervention[n]-mu_intervention), evaluating parentheses, multiplication, then addition in that order
numeric_contract.comparison: Numeric fixture values compare by exact float64 equality. Status strings, IDs, arrays, tables, and object keys compare by normalized deep equality after ordering exactly as specified.
numeric_contract.nonfinite_token: The JSON string NONFINITE_NAN is materialized as the IEEE-754 quiet NaN value only for the named input sample before running the primitive.
numeric_contract.fixture_length_override: For normalization_oracles only, invoke the exact mean/variance/rescale primitive with N equal to the listed array length and bypass only the production shape/length gate. Production use remains exactly N=36000 and shape (36000,); fixture arrays can never enter science.

fixture_projection_overrides.detector_comparator_oracles: Each listed candidate object is the complete fixture-only projection consumed directly by the named SO or spindle comparator. Bypass raw-array construction, filtering, threshold derivation, production event-row construction, and official-table validation only for this comparator primitive; evaluate every supplied field and the exact equality/strict-edge rule, and reject any missing or extra candidate field.
fixture_projection_overrides.matching_and_block_event_oracles: For matching_oracle and block_event_oracles only, each event row is exactly the two-key projection {event_id,anchor_sample}. Require a unique nonempty string event_id and a JSON-integer anchor_sample, reject missing/extra keys, preserve listed source order, and bypass only the full production SO/SPINDLE event-row schema and detector/table-integrity gates. Feed these projections to the exact candidate enumeration, sort, greedy match, unmatched-side, and integer-count primitives without inventing duration, amplitude, boundary, or event-type values.
fixture_projection_overrides.condition_pooling_oracles: For each condition_pooling_oracle, the constructed B001 through B030 rows are the complete local expected block universe in exactly ascending numeric order. Bypass only the production RV5B block-ID formula, 36-block expected universe, full block-record field schema, and record-payload hash. Still enforce the exact Level-A thresholds of at least 30 valid blocks, at least five distinct seeds, and at least five distinct draws; apply the exact INVALID_* first-ordered-block priority, NOT_ESTIMABLE exclusion, pooled integer formulas, decision statuses, and null Boolean semantics. No unlisted B row exists in this fixture mode.
fixture_projection_overrides.scope_prohibition: Every override in this object is legal only while executing PF_RESCALE_EVENT_VETO_FIXTURE_V5 before science. A fixture projection, B identifier, reduced row, local universe, or bypass must never be accepted by a production rescale-veto record, scientific run, pooled condition, claim, or result artifact; such reuse is PF_RESCALE_EVENT_VETO_FAIL.

numeric_contract.oracle_modes: normalization_oracles test numeric primitives; detector_comparator_oracles test frozen comparator/edge primitives from exact fixture projections; matching_oracle tests the pair enumerator/sort/greedy matcher on exact two-key projections; block_event_oracles test count construction from those projections; condition_pooling_oracles test denominator/pooling/status logic on the exact local B001-B030 universe. The only bypasses are enumerated in fixture_length_override and fixture_projection_overrides. No oracle is represented as an end-to-end model trajectory or scientific result.

matching_oracle.boundary_rule: Absolute difference exactly 50 is eligible; 51 is ineligible.

condition_pooling_oracles.construction: For q=0,...,29 in ascending order set block_id='B'+three-digit(q+1), parameter_draw_id=[D00_NOMINAL,D01,D02,D03,D04][floor(q/6)], and seed=[11003,22007,33013,44017,55021,66029][q mod 6]; every block is EVENT_ALL_ADDED_VANISH.

For q=0,...,29 in ascending order set block_id='B'+three-digit(q+1), parameter_draw_id=[D00_NOMINAL,D01,D02,D03,D04][floor(q/6)], and seed=[11003,22007,33013,44017,55021,66029][q mod 6]; every block is EVENT_NONZERO_SURVIVAL.

For q=0,...,29 in ascending order set block_id='B'+three-digit(q+1), parameter_draw_id=[D00_NOMINAL,D01,D02,D03,D04][floor(q/6)], and seed=[11003,22007,33013,44017,55021,66029][q mod 6]; every block is EVENT_NO_ADDED_EVENTS.
Use the exact B001-B030 draw-seed mapping above and set every intervention trajectory to MV_ZERO_INTERVENTION_VARIANCE.
Use the exact B001-B030 draw-seed mapping above with EVENT_NONZERO_SURVIVAL; before moment calculation replace intervention array index 1 in B017 with NONFINITE_NAN.

comparison_contract.pass_rule: Materialize only the declared fixture inputs, execute the V5 primitives in execution_order, consume every input row exactly once, and deep-equal every expected value, array, pair order, count, status, and null.
comparison_contract.failure_rule: Any missing/extra case, unconsumed row, numeric inequality, ordering difference, unexpected exception, or status difference emits PF_RESCALE_EVENT_VETO_FAIL and stops before scientific Phase 2A.
